hypotheses.C1_same_family_native_support_overlaps_m: Mean discovery top-256 Jaccard is at least 0.02 higher within human families than between families at both layers.
hypotheses.C2_same_family_contribution_profiles_are: Mean cosine of absolute discovery contribution profiles is at least 0.05 higher within families at both layers.
hypotheses.C3_signed_common_bank_matches_magnitude_: Rank-256 signed-common downstream fidelity is within 0.05 of the mean-absolute bank in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.C4_recurrence_bank_matches_magnitude_ban: Rank-256 recurrence-ranked downstream fidelity is within 0.05 of the mean-absolute bank in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.C5_family_banks_contain_recurrent_channe: At least half of each rank-256 recurrence bank appears in the per-pair top-256 set of two or more discovery members, after excluding the evaluated pair.
hypotheses.C6_recurrent_channels_have_consistent_si: The median sign agreement of recurrent channels across LOPO discovery members is at least 0.67 at both layers.
hypotheses.C7_layer1_has_more_support_reuse: The same-minus-different family Jaccard advantage is at least 0.02 larger at Layer 1 than Layer 0.
hypotheses.C8_common_banks_transfer_ood: TinyStories rank-256 signed-common and recurrence fidelities each retain at least 75% of FineWeb at both layers.
